license_required.quote: An individual may not engage in, carry on, advertise or purport to engage in or carry on professional real estate activity, or act in the capacity of a real estate licensee, within this state unless the individual holds an active license as provided for in this chapter.

issuing_authority.quote: The Real Estate Agency shall establish by rule a system for licensing real estate brokers, principal real estate brokers, licensed real estate property managers and timeshare sales agents.

name.quote: The Real Estate Agency shall establish by rule a system for licensing real estate brokers, principal real estate brokers, licensed real estate property managers and timeshare sales agents.

type.quote: The Real Estate Agency is established.

age_minimum.quote: Certification that the applicant is at least 18 years of age.

moral_character_required.quote: A license for a real estate broker, principal real estate broker, licensed real estate property manager or timeshare sales agent may be granted only to an individual who is trustworthy and competent to conduct professional real estate activity in a manner that protects the public interest.

degree_required.quote: Certification by the applicant that the applicant has a high school diploma or a certificate for passing an approved high school equivalency test such as the General Educational Development (GED) test or the international equivalent, or other equivalent education acceptable to the commissioner

degree_level.quote: Certification by the applicant that the applicant has a high school diploma or a certificate for passing an approved high school equivalency test such as the General Educational Development (GED) test or the international equivalent, or other equivalent education acceptable to the commissioner

school_approval_basis.quote: In order to satisfy the educational requirements under subsections (2) to (5) and (7) of this section, a course must be approved by the commissioner.

credential_pegged.quote: Certification by the applicant that the applicant has a high school diploma or a certificate for passing an approved high school equivalency test such as the General Educational Development (GED) test or the international equivalent, or other equivalent education acceptable to the commissioner

required.quote: For an applicant to qualify for a real estate broker's license, the Real Estate Commissioner must receive: Certification by the applicant that the applicant has a high school diploma or a certificate for passing an approved high school equivalency test

experience_source.quote: For an applicant to qualify for a real estate broker's license, the Real Estate Commissioner must receive: Certification by the applicant that the applicant has a high school diploma or a certificate for passing an approved high school equivalency test

exams.name: Real estate broker's examination
exams.notes: Required for real estate broker license; content and passing score set by agency rule.
exams.quote: Has passed the real estate broker's examination required by the agency by rule

exams.name: Principal real estate broker's examination
exams.notes: Required for principal real estate broker license; also requires 3 years active licensed experience and completion of brokerage administration and sales supervision course.
exams.quote: Has passed the principal real estate broker's examination required by the agency by rule

required.quote: To renew an active license or to reactivate a license for the first time since the license was renewed to an inactive status, a real estate licensee, other than a timeshare sales agent, must complete 30 hours of real estate continuing education courses that are eligible for credit under ORS 696.182 during the two years preceding the renewal or reactivation.

hours_per_period.quote: must complete 30 hours of real estate continuing education courses that are eligible for credit under ORS 696.182 during the two years preceding the renewal or reactivation.

period_years.quote: during the two years preceding the renewal or reactivation.

value: At least two hours in a course approved by the Real Estate Board on recent changes in real estate rule and law
At least two hours in a course approved by the Real Estate Board on state and federal fair housing laws
Advanced course in real estate practices (for broker renewing active license for first time or reactivating)
topical_requirements.quote: The 30 hours must include: (a) At least two hours in a course approved by the Real Estate Board on recent changes in real estate rule and law; (b) At least two hours in a course approved by the Real Estate Board on state and federal fair housing laws; and (c)(A) If the real estate broker is renewing an active license for the first time or reactivating a license for the first time since renewing the license to an inactive status, an advanced course in real estate practices approved by the Real Estate Agency

available.quote: the Real Estate Commissioner may prescribe by rule the terms and conditions for license recognition of a nonresident real estate broker or salesperson and for reciprocity agreements with other states and countries

requirements.value: Commissioner prescribes by rule terms and conditions for license recognition of nonresident real estate brokers and for reciprocity agreements with other states and countries, including application procedures, license qualifications, license maintenance, limitations on activities and license renewal requirements. An individual licensed in another state or country may also qualify by completing the required course of study and passing the license examination.
requirements.quote: An individual licensed to engage in professional real estate activity in another state or country may qualify for a principal real estate broker license, real estate broker license, real estate property manager license or timeshare sales agent license if the individual successfully completes the course of study for and passes the license examination corresponding to the license for which the individual applies, both as prescribed by agency rule, and if the individual meets the other requirements for licensure in this chapter.

exists.quote: The Real Estate Board is established within the Real Estate Agency. The board shall consist of nine members appointed by the Governor

name.quote: The Real Estate Board is established within the Real Estate Agency.

authority.value: The board is authorized to inquire into the needs of real estate licensees, confer with and advise the Governor, make recommendations and suggestions of policy to the agency, make recommendations about examination methods, and create or approve continuing education courses on recent changes in real estate rule and law. When the agency proposes to adopt, amend or repeal a rule concerning real estate licensees, the agency must submit a copy to the board and consider any recommendations the board makes by majority vote.
authority.quote: The Real Estate Board is authorized to inquire into the needs of the real estate licensees of Oregon, the functions of the Real Estate Agency and the matter of the business policy thereof, to confer with and advise the Governor as to how the agency may best serve the state and the licensees, and to make recommendations and suggestions of policy to the agency

disciplinary_grounds.description: Created a reasonable probability of damage or injury by making material misrepresentations or false promises in a matter related to professional real estate activity.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Created a reasonable probability of damage or injury to a person by making one or more material misrepresentations or false promises in a matter related to professional real estate activity.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Represented, attempted to represent, or accepted compensation from a managing principal broker other than the one with whom the licensee is associated.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Represented, attempted to represent or accepted compensation from a managing principal broker other than the managing principal broker with whom the real estate licensee is associated.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disregarded or violated any provision of applicable statutes or any rule of the Real Estate Agency.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Disregarded or violated any provision of ORS 659A.421, 696.010 to 696.495, 696.600 to 696.785, 696.800 to 696.870 and 696.890 or any rule of the Real Estate Agency.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly or recklessly published materially misleading or untruthful advertising.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly or recklessly published materially misleading or untruthful advertising.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acted as an agent and an undisclosed principal in any transaction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Acted as an agent and an undisclosed principal in any transaction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Intentionally interfered with the contractual relations of others concerning real estate or professional real estate activity.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Intentionally interfered with the contractual relations of others concerning real estate or professional real estate activity.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Intentionally interfered with the exclusive representation or exclusive brokerage relationship of another real estate licensee.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Intentionally interfered with the exclusive representation or exclusive brokerage relationship of another real estate licensee.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Accepted employment or compensation for a competitive market analysis or letter opinion contingent upon a predetermined value or for real estate in which the licensee had an undisclosed interest.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Accepted employment or compensation for the preparation of a competitive market analysis or letter opinion that is contingent upon reporting a predetermined value or for real estate in which the real estate licensee had an undisclosed interest.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Represented a taxpayer in tax proceedings contingent upon a predetermined value or for real estate in which the licensee had an undisclosed interest.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Represented a taxpayer as described in ORS 305.239 or 309.100, contingent upon reporting a predetermined value or for real estate in which the real estate licensee had an undisclosed interest.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to ensure that buyer and seller received a complete detailed closing statement in any transaction in which the licensee performed the closing.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failed to ensure, in any real estate transaction in which the real estate licensee performed the closing, that the buyer and seller received a complete detailed closing statement showing the amount and purpose of all receipts, adjustments and disbursements.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convicted of a felony or misdemeanor substantially related to the licensee's trustworthiness or competence to engage in professional real estate activity.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted of a felony or misdemeanor substantially related to the real estate licensee's trustworthiness or competence to engage in professional real estate activity.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Demonstrated incompetence or untrustworthiness in performing any act for which the licensee is required to hold a license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Demonstrated incompetence or untrustworthiness in performing any act for which the real estate licensee is required to hold a license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated a term, condition, restriction or limitation contained in an order issued by the commissioner.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violated a term, condition, restriction or limitation contained in an order issued by the commissioner.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committed an act of fraud or engaged in dishonest conduct substantially related to the fitness of the applicant or licensee to conduct professional real estate activity.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committed an act of fraud or engaged in dishonest conduct substantially related to the fitness of the applicant or real estate licensee to conduct professional real estate activity, without regard to whether the act or conduct occurred in the course of professional real estate activity.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in conduct below the standard of care for the practice of professional real estate activity in Oregon.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaged in any conduct that is below the standard of care for the practice of professional real estate activity in Oregon as established by the community of individuals engaged in the practice of professional real estate activity in Oregon.

disciplinary_grounds.description: If the licensee is a managing principal broker, failed to exercise reasonable supervision and control over the activities of associated real estate licensees.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: If the licensee is a managing principal broker, failed to exercise reasonable supervision and control over the activities of associated real estate licensees.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: A licensed real estate property manager or managing principal broker shall: (a) Establish and maintain in this state a place of business designated as the real estate licensee's main office; (b) Register the main office with the Real Estate Agency under a registered business name

definition_quote.value: 'Professional real estate activity' means any of the following actions, when engaged in for another and for compensation or with the intention or in the expectation or upon the promise of receiving or collecting compensation, by any person who: (a) Sells, exchanges, purchases, rents or leases real estate; (b) Offers to sell, exchange, purchase, rent or lease real estate; (c) Negotiates, offers, attempts or agrees to negotiate the sale, exchange, purchase, rental or leasing of real estate; (d) Lists, offers, attempts or agrees to list real estate for sale; ...
definition_quote.quote: "Professional real estate activity" means any of the following actions, when engaged in for another and for compensation or with the intention or in the expectation or upon the promise of receiving or collecting compensation

agency_relationship_types.quote: A real estate licensee may represent both the seller and the buyer in a real estate transaction as a disclosed limited agent under a disclosed limited agency agreement

dual_agency_written_consent_required.quote: A real estate licensee may represent both the seller and the buyer in a real estate transaction as a disclosed limited agent under a disclosed limited agency agreement, with full disclosure of the relationship under the agreement.

designated_agency_permitted.quote: In a real estate transaction in which different real estate licensees associated with the same managing principal broker establish agency relationships with different parties to the real estate transaction, the managing principal broker shall be the only broker acting as a disclosed limited agent representing both seller and buyer. Other brokers shall continue to represent only the party with whom the broker has an agency relationship unless all parties agree otherwise in writing.

initial_interview_disclosure_required.quote: An agent shall provide a copy of the initial agency disclosure pamphlet at the first contact with each party to a real property transaction, including but not limited to contacts in person, by telephone, over the Internet or the World Wide Web, or by electronic mail, electronic bulletin board or a similar electronic method.

written_service_agreement_required.quote: A real estate licensee representing a seller in a transaction is required to act under a written listing agreement with the seller.

listing_contract_termination_date_requir.quote: A real estate licensee may not enter into a listing agreement if the duration of the listing agreement, including any automatic renewals of the listing agreement, exceeds 24 months.

transaction_record_retention_years.quote: records under this section must be maintained by the real estate licensee for a period of not less than six years after the following date: ... For real estate transactions, the date a transaction closed or failed, whichever is later

escrow_account_required.quote: A managing principal broker who receives or handles trust funds and does not deposit the trust funds in a licensed neutral escrow depository ... shall open and maintain in this state one or more separate federally insured bank accounts that are designated clients' trust accounts under ORS 696.245.

commingling_of_funds_prohibited.quote: A principal real estate broker or licensed real estate property manager may not commingle any other funds with the trust funds held in a clients' trust account

fixed_office_required.quote: A licensed real estate property manager or managing principal broker shall: (a) Establish and maintain in this state a place of business designated as the real estate licensee's main office

branch_office_associate_broker_required.quote: Only a managing principal broker or principal real estate broker with a written supervisory agreement permitting the principal real estate broker to supervise licensees may control or supervise a main office, branch office or portions of an office.

salesperson_broker_affiliation_required.quote: A real estate broker may engage in professional real estate activity only if the broker is associated with a managing principal broker and supervised by the same managing principal broker.

qualified_association_permitted.quote: a principal real estate broker or a real estate licensee, other than a timeshare sales agent, associated with a managing principal broker may create a corporation, limited liability company, limited liability partnership or other lawfully constituted business organization for the purpose of receiving compensation.

wholesale_transaction_cancellation_right.quote: A seller or buyer who enters into a written contract for a residential property wholesale transaction may cancel the contract without penalty by delivery of a written notice of cancellation any time before 12 midnight at the end of the third business day after the receipt of the residential property wholesaler written disclosure.

broker_price_opinion_permitted.quote: "Competitive market analysis" means a method or process used by a real estate licensee in pursuing a listing agreement or in formulating an offer to acquire real estate in a transaction for the sale, lease, lease-option or exchange of real estate.

comparative_market_analysis_permitted.quote: "Competitive market analysis" means a method or process used by a real estate licensee in pursuing a listing agreement or in formulating an offer to acquire real estate in a transaction for the sale, lease, lease-option or exchange of real estate. The objective of competitive market analysis is a recommended listing, selling or purchase price or a lease or rental consideration.
